mechanics.claim: Toggling the ability off (or its final forced deactivation) triggers one final damage tick before ending.
mechanics.quote: Toggling ''Glacial Storm'' off triggers a final tick of damage and incurs its full cooldown.

mechanics.claim: The blizzard deals 3 half-damage ticks (totaling 1.5 normal ticks worth of damage) before it grows to full size and starts dealing empowered damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Glacial Storm'' deals 3 half ticks at {{ap|200|267|333}} radius for a total of {{fd|1.5}} normal damage ticks before it starts dealing empowered damage at 400 radius.

mechanics.claim: Toggled activations of Glacial Storm do not count as an ability cast for on-cast trigger effects.
mechanics.quote: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown only begins once the storm itself has disappeared, not on toggle-off.
Glacial Storm is automatically toggled off if Anivia moves too far from it, cannot pay its per-second mana cost, or is hit by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
mechanics.quote: ''Glacial Storm'' is toggled off automatically if '''Anivia''' moves too far away from the blizzard or becomes unable to pay the {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost, or is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.

mechanics.claim: Stasis (e.g. Zhonya's Hourglass) does not interrupt an active Glacial Storm, but Devour (Tahm Kench) does.
